He was a sage and poet, known for his profound wisdom and hallowed knowledge of sacred texts.

It echoes the belief in the importance of learning, understanding oneself and the world, and using knowledge to evolve spiritually and contribute positively to society. Ultimately, Senu is seen as a symbol of the spiritual goal of attaining wisdom and inner peace.
